comment: Kept our rescued kitten here for 6 days after her spay surgery. They sent WhatsApp video updates twice a day, administered her antibiotics on time, and kept the room spotless.
Super caring hosts right on Dhanmondi Road 10. Easy to locate on Google Maps with secure entry and quiet rooms. Genuinely compassionate people.
Best foster in Uttara Sector 7! Fully netted windows, separate quarantine rooms for newcomers, and veterinary checkups on request. Highly recommend.
Fostered an abandoned golden retriever here until his forever family was screened. Transparent, professional, and dedicated.
Helped us take in an injured street dog from Mohammadpur late at night when no other shelter answered. True lifesavers for Dhaka's street animals.
Very calm home environment in Mirpur DOHS. Completely cage-free, safe play areas, and great quality cat food provided.
Climate-controlled, immaculately clean facility in Gulshan 2. On-call vet visits and wonderful caretakers. My Persian cat felt right at home.
So grateful to have a verified foster network in Chattogram! Safe Paws in Panchlaish took wonderful care of our rescue pup and helped with vaccinations.
